**Chicago** holds by far the largest share of the system‑wide "Other" deposits line under Deposits in Table 6.

- Chicago: **$164,338 million**
- System total ("Other" line): **$234,208 million**

This gives Chicago roughly **70%** (164,338 ÷ 234,208 ≈ 70.2%) of the total "Other" deposits reported across all twelve Reserve Banks—far more than any other district (the next largest, New York, holds about $68,716 million, or ~29%).
